about.title: أثر means the mark that remains.
about.lead: A trace, an imprint, an effect — what is left after you have gone. It is also what we are hired to leave behind.
story: In Arabic, ب ت ث share one skeleton. What makes a ث a ث is the three dots placed above it. Businesses are the same: most need similar skeletons — accounts, orders, approvals, dashboards. What makes a system theirs is how it is shaped around their people, their language and their workflow.

ATHR builds the skeleton properly, then places the mark. We started because too many companies in the region were paying for templates with their logo on top, or for developer hours with nobody accountable for the result.
We work in Arabic and English from the first meeting, we visit before we quote, and we hand over everything we build.

sections.heading: What we collect
sections.body: If you send us a message through the contact form we keep your name, company, phone number, email and what you wrote, so that we can reply. We do not collect anything else about you on this site.

sections.heading: Analytics
sections.body: We count page views and which contact buttons are pressed, in aggregate. We do not use advertising cookies and we do not build a profile of you.

sections.heading: WhatsApp and phone
sections.body: Messaging us on WhatsApp or calling us is governed by your own agreement with those providers. Your message reaches us the same way any customer message would.

sections.heading: How long we keep it
sections.body: We keep enquiries for as long as we are in conversation, and for a reasonable period afterwards in case you come back to us.

sections.heading: Your choices
sections.body: Ask us to delete your details at any time and we will, then confirm it in writing.

sections.heading: About this site
sections.body: This site describes the services ATHR offers. Nothing on it is a binding quote or a contract.

sections.heading: Project work
sections.body: Every project runs under a written agreement signed by both sides, covering scope, price, timing, ownership and support.

sections.heading: Ownership
sections.body: On full payment for a phase, the source code, designs and documentation produced in that phase are yours.

sections.heading: Our work shown here
sections.body: Project pages describe work we did with the permission of the client. Client names and marks remain theirs.

sections.heading: Accuracy
sections.body: We keep this site current, but we do not guarantee that every figure on it is up to date at the moment you read it.
